newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece to drain 200bln drs via depo tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece to drain 200bln drs via depo tender.

text.p: Greece's central bank offered to drain up to 200 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent through a fixed interest rate tender on Wednesday, it said in a statement.
Payment date is May 7 and maturity value date is May 21, it said.

"In case of oversubscription, bids will be satisfied pro rata, with a minimum allotment of 500 million drachmas. The Bank of Greece reserves the right to accept a higher total amount of deposits if this is viewed as enhancing the effectiveness of the auction," it said.
Bids should be submitted by fax between 1130 local (0830 GMT) and 1230 (0930 GMT).
